footer: Hournook, online booking for small businesses.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.preheader: Confirm your email address to finish setting up Hournook.
verify.heading: Welcome, {name}
verify.body: Confirm your email address so we can send you booking notifications and keep your account secure.
verify.expiry: This link expires in 24 hours. If you did not create a Hournook account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Hournook password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
reset.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour and can be used once. If you did not ask for this, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will not change.

invite.subject: You're invited to join {business}
invite.preheader: {inviter} invited you to join {business} on Hournook.
invite.heading: Join {business}
invite.body: {inviter} invited you to join {business} on Hournook as {role}. You'll be able to see your appointments and manage your availability.

paymentFailed.subject: Action needed: payment failed for {business}
paymentFailed.heading: We couldn’t process your payment
paymentFailed.text: Your latest Hournook payment for {business} didn’t go through. We’ll retry automatically, but please update your payment method to avoid your booking page being paused.

active.subject: Your Hournook subscription is active
active.heading: Thanks, you’re all set
active.text: Your subscription for {business} is active. Your booking page will keep accepting bookings without interruption.

canceled.subject: Your Hournook subscription has ended
canceled.heading: Your subscription has ended
canceled.text: The subscription for {business} has been cancelled. Your data is safe and your dashboard is still available, but your booking page no longer accepts new bookings. You can resubscribe at any time.
